show.name: Shixiong A Shixiong
show.summary:
After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator.

To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities.
Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

show.name: Notes of DNA Appraiser
show.summary: Notes of DNA Appraiser tells the story of Xu Ziqi, a rookie DNA paternity tester. Under the guidance of Mo Li, director of the Xin Nuo Paternity Testing Center, she teams up with the passionate young man Zhu Xinchen. Together, they fearlessly confront a stream of appraisal cases and uncover all kinds of life truths.

show.name: The Palace Gambit
show.summary: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!

show.name: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
show.summary: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

show.name: Wherever Whoever Whatever
show.summary: Overworked, Bai Luoru flees to a village. With local support, she heals her past and mother's bond to live again.

show.name: Zhu Xian
show.summary: A terrible calamity has fallen onto Zhang Fan, not only becoming one of the three survivors of Grass Temple Village, where everyone else was horribly massacred, he was also tasked to carry one of the most evil artifacts, the Sinister Bead, and taught one of the most secret teachings of the Skysong Sect, the Brahmin Wisdom. Now he cultivates in the Jadeon Sect, his knowledge and possession will draw him into a chaotic story where he will have to carry some of the greatest burdens of the Martial World.

show.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
show.summary: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

show.name: The Great Long March
show.summary: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.
